future_memory_interface.current: Combat::tick is local, deterministic and independent of network calls. Movement, health, damage and hit timing stay here.
future_memory_interface.extension: Optional nonblocking intent mailbox: encounter generation, actor ID, target suggestion, stance, issued tick and short TTL. Validate locally; discard stale/mismatched intents.
future_memory_interface.memory: Summaries of encounters can be persisted by an external worker after bounded event emission. Text/model replies must not supply coordinates, health edits or native commands.
future_memory_interface.fallback: Missing, late or invalid replies keep the existing local behavior running. No API/server/listener added in this pass.
